headline.caveat: ~$11B total anticipated contract revenue across 400MW at Polaris Forge 1 (Ellendale, ND): two ~15-year leases (~$7B, May 2025) plus a 150MW expansion (Aug 2025). Press estimates including options range up to ~$16B; campus designed to scale to 1GW.

realized_to_date.caveat: First 100MW building reached ready-for-service Q4 2025; second building mid-2026; rent flowing but cumulative amounts not broken out.

nature_md: CoreWeave leases 400MW of critical IT capacity across ~15-year leases at Applied Digital's Polaris Forge 1 campus in Ellendale, North Dakota (~$11B anticipated contract revenue; first building RFS Q4 2025, second mid-2026, third by 2027). Applied Digital builds and owns the powered shells; CoreWeave installs its GPU fleet and resells capacity — much of it ultimately serving OpenAI and other lab contracts, making this a load-bearing link in the compute sublease chain.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: CoreWeave capitalizes leases as ROU assets/lease liabilities (adding to its ~$30B debt-plus-lease stack) and expenses rent through cost of revenue against contracted customer commitments.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Applied Digital books lease revenue from each building's ready-for-service date; the $11B backlog (within $36.2B total AI leases per FY26 10-K) anchors project financing for the campus buildout.

both_sides_md: **Bull:** contracted, credit-enhanced revenue converts APLD from speculative developer to landlord with a fortress backlog. **Bear:** CoreWeave itself is a leveraged intermediary (CDS implying ~50% 5-yr default probability in Jul 2026); APLD's backlog quality is only as good as CoreWeave's own customer book.
